generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: Evidence can be collected successfully but credential-bearing bytes can still be persisted or uploaded if safety checks run before final collection or are not a hard dependency of publication.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Redact one known diagnostic field while leaving headers, cookies, raw response payloads, or later-collected logs able to carry secrets into published evidence.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Authentication/session evidence must persist only allowlisted metadata and never raw credential-bearing values.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Scan final evidence bytes after all collection and before publication; fail closed without echoing detected values.

transfer_cases.evidence: Structured credential fixture is rejected while redacted metadata passes.
Authorization and session-cookie fixtures are rejected without echoing values.

skill_changes.evidence: Generic delivery guidance requires allowlisted authentication diagnostics and final-byte evidence safety.
Generic delivery guidance requires fail-closed post-collection pre-publication detection.
